title: Nextcloud Activity File Size Leaderboard
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nextcloud:activity file_size_mb=*
| stats sum(file_size_mb) as total_value, avg(file_size_mb) as avg_value by user_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks user values by total and average file size across Nextcloud activity events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `file_size_mb` values for each Nextcloud activity event and review total and average file size by user.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total file size.
grandmaExplanation: It neatly which user shows the biggest file size numbers in your Nextcloud activity data.
